visual.name: bfusionResourceKPI
visual.description: Responsive resource KPI card dashboard showing capacity, demand, allocation, availability, time-off, overallocation, allocation-distribution breakdown, and Utilization + Bench Ratio gauges with dynamic insight panel.

dataRoles.name: capacity
dataRoles.description: Total resource capacity in hours — SUM(Capacity[Capacity]).

dataRoles.name: allocatedResources
dataRoles.description: Count of resources with scheduled allocation.

dataRoles.name: overallocatedResources
dataRoles.description: Count of resources >100% in any month.

dataRoles.name: underutilizedResources
dataRoles.description: Count of resources with peak <25% across months.

dataRoles.name: topOverallocName
dataRoles.description: Name of the most overallocated resource (optional).

dataRoles.name: topOverallocPeak
dataRoles.description: Peak allocation % of the most overallocated resource (as decimal, e.g. 1.45 = 145%).

dataRoles.name: licenseToken
dataRoles.description: Bind to the single-cell BFusionLicense[Key] column in your model

hoursPerDay.description: Used to convert hours to days (default 8).

gauges.description: Utilization and Bench Ratio semi-circle gauges.

utilLowMax.description: Below this % the status is LOW. Default 60.

utilHighMin.description: At or above this % the status is HIGH. Default 85.

utilMax.description: Right end of the utilization gauge arc. Default 150.

benchLowMax.description: Below this % the bench assessment is Low. Default 15.

benchHighMin.description: At or above this % the bench assessment is High. Default 35.

benchMax.description: Right end of the bench gauge arc. Default 50.

fontSizes.description: Font size (px) for each text element.

cardLabelFs.description: Small label above each KPI value (e.g. 'Total Capacity').

cardUnitFs.description: Unit shown next to the KPI value (e.g. 'hrs', 'resources').

cardSubFs.description: Secondary line under each KPI (e.g. '529 days · 83.5% allocated').

ringFs.description: Percentage label inside the donut ring.

distribSubtitleFs.description: Subtitle line and the bucket legend below the bar.

insightHeadlineFs.description: Bold headline inside the Insight Panel rows.

insightDetailFs.description: Detail line under each insight headline.

cardBandMetaFs.description: Right-aligned small text inside each card's colored band.

panelSubFs.description: Right-aligned subtitle in each section panel header.

licenseKey.description: Paste your BFusion license key here. Contact info@bfusion.eu for a license.
